# Configuration parameters (generated)

<!-- Generated by `uv run ccil config docs`; edit src/ccil/config/params.py, not this file. -->

Resolve and validate a configuration; raise ConfigError listing every problem.

Values in files are YAML; numbers with units may be written `"<n> <unit>"` with exactly the declared unit. Command-line values are parsed by type: booleans accept only `true` or `false`; lists accept `a,b` or `[a, b]`; nullable values accept `null`.

`declared` parameters are validated and documented now and consumed by the milestone shown.

## run

| Key | Type | Default | Units | Domain | Status | Description | Rationale | Replaces |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `run.seed` | int | `42` | - | [0, inf] | implemented | Seed for every random choice in the run, including the trajectory split. | Legacy default seed in every config. | `seed` |
| `run.output_dir` | path | `"runs"` | - | - | implemented | Directory under which run directories are created. | Replaces output.location; run directories are named by run ID. | `output.location` |
| `run.overwrite` | bool | `false` | - | - | implemented | Replace an existing run directory with the same run ID. | Legacy scripts always overwrote; the core refuses unless asked. | `overwrite` |

## transition_model

| Key | Type | Default | Units | Domain | Status | Description | Rationale | Replaces |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `transition_model.trainer_version` | choice | `"1"` | - | `1`, `2` | implemented | How mlp transition models are fitted (#110). | 1 fits each model with its own loop (MLPTransitionModel.fit); 2 with the batched engine (models/mlp_batched.py), which study runners use to fit many seeds together. Same protocol, not bit-compatible, so the version is part of the stage identity. | - |
| `transition_model.fit_episodes` | choice | `"all"` | - | `all`, `train` | implemented | Episodes the label model is fitted on. | all (legacy) fits it on every episode, and a separate evaluation model on the train split is scored on the held-out episodes; train fits the label model on the train split only, so held-out episodes influence no training label (a clean holdout), and that model is the one scored. | - |
| `transition_model.kind` | choice | `"mlp"` | - | `linear`, `mlp` | implemented | Transition-model family: linear (least squares) or mlp. | Legacy code used an MLP (WorldModel), ported in #21; mlp needs the ccil[torch] extra (Python 3.11+). | - |
| `transition_model.direction` | choice | `"forward"` | - | `forward`, `backward` | implemented | Fit s_{t+1} from (s_t, a_t), or s_t from (s_{t+1}, a_t). | Legacy dynamics.backward, absent (forward) in every config. | `dynamics.backward` |
| `transition_model.lipschitz_type` | choice | `null` | - | `none`, `spectral_normalization`, `slack`, `spectral_normalization_slack`, `soft_sampling`, `soft_sampling_slack`, `soft_jac` | implemented | Lipschitz regularization of the transition model. | Task-specific in legacy configs. | `dynamics.lipschitz_type` |
| `transition_model.lipschitz_constraint` | float | `null` | - | (0.0, inf] | implemented | Target Lipschitz bound. | Task-specific (1.0-4.0) in legacy configs. | `dynamics.lipschitz_constraint` |
| `transition_model.lipschitz_coordinates` | choice | `"model_normalized"` | - | `raw`, `model_normalized` | implemented | Coordinates of the sampled Lipschitz penalties (soft_sampling, soft_sampling_slack): the ratio hinged at lipschitz_constraint. | model_normalized (#125) perturbs the model's normalized inputs and compares its normalized residuals: a dimensionless ratio, invariant to units and timestep, in the space the network is optimized in. raw (#21) uses raw residuals over raw perturbations, so the constant depends on units and timestep (on continuous Pendulum it never binds at 2). Legacy mixed the two. The penalty is a training regularizer, never a certified bound. soft_jac supports raw only. | - |
| `transition_model.soft_penalty_weight` | float | `null` | - | [0.0, inf] | implemented | Weight of the soft Lipschitz penalty. | Task-specific in legacy configs. | `dynamics.soft_lipschitz_penalty_weight` |
| `transition_model.soft_sampling_eps` | float | `0.0003` | state units | (0.0, inf] | implemented | Perturbation radius for sampled Lipschitz estimates. | Same value in every legacy config. | `dynamics.soft_lipschitz_sampling_eps` |
| `transition_model.soft_samples` | int | `5` | - | [1, inf] | declared (M3 (#21)) | Samples per point for sampled Lipschitz estimates. | Same value in every legacy config. | `dynamics.soft_lipschitz_n_samples` |
| `transition_model.slack_weight` | float | `1.0` | - | [0.0, inf] | implemented | Weight of the slack penalty. | Legacy code default when slack_weight is absent. | `dynamics.slack_weight` |
| `transition_model.learning_rate` | float | `0.001` | - | (0.0, inf] | implemented | Adam learning rate. | Same value in every legacy config. | `dynamics.lr` |
| `transition_model.weight_decay` | float | `1e-05` | - | [0.0, inf] | implemented | Adam weight decay. | Same value in every legacy config. | `dynamics.weight_decay` |
| `transition_model.hidden_layers` | ints | `null` | - | [1, inf] | implemented | Hidden layer widths. | Task-specific in legacy configs. | `dynamics.layers` |
| `transition_model.activation` | choice | `"relu"` | - | `relu`, `tanh` | implemented | Hidden activation. | Same value in every legacy config. | `dynamics.activation` |
| `transition_model.epochs` | int | `null` | - | [1, inf] | implemented | Training epochs. | Task-specific in legacy configs. | `dynamics.train_epochs` |
| `transition_model.batch_size` | int | `null` | - | [1, inf] | implemented | Minibatch size. | Task-specific in legacy configs. | `dynamics.batch_size` |

## certificate

| Key | Type | Default | Units | Domain | Status | Description | Rationale | Replaces |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `certificate.profile` | choice | `null` | - | `continuity`, `backtrack`, `disturbed_action`, `backtrack_paper_proxy`, `disturbed_action_paper_proxy`, `legacy_label_filtering` | implemented | Certify the labels with this profile (labels.certify); null skips it. | Replaces the label-filtering estimate (#88). Bound profiles: continuity, backtrack, disturbed_action. Score profiles: backtrack_paper_proxy, disturbed_action_paper_proxy, legacy_label_filtering. | - |
| `certificate.reference_dynamics` | path | `null` | - | - | implemented | ccil.reference-dynamics file of the true dynamics: the source of analytic constants and demonstration residuals. | Known only for analytic systems; without it the true constants and the demonstration residual bound are declared, and the certificate is conditional. | - |
| `certificate.true_state_lipschitz` | float | `null` | error per scaled state | [0.0, inf] | implemented | Declared state Lipschitz constant K_z of the true dynamics. | An assumption, recorded as such (conditional); used without certificate.reference_dynamics. | - |
| `certificate.true_action_lipschitz` | float | `null` | error per scaled action | [0.0, inf] | implemented | Declared action Lipschitz constant K_a of the true dynamics. | An assumption, recorded as such (conditional); used without certificate.reference_dynamics. | - |
| `certificate.learned_lipschitz_source` | choice | `"model"` | - | `model`, `declared` | implemented | Source of the learned state constant K_hat_z. | model computes it from the frozen checkpoint (verified for linear models, conditional for MLPs); declared uses certificate.learned_state_lipschitz. | - |
| `certificate.learned_state_lipschitz` | float | `null` | error per scaled state | [0.0, inf] | implemented | Declared state Lipschitz constant K_hat_z of the model. | Used when certificate.learned_lipschitz_source is declared. | - |
| `certificate.discrepancy_state_lipschitz` | float | `null` | error per scaled state | [0.0, inf] | implemented | Declared state constant C_z of the continuity profile (variation of f - f_hat). | Used by continuity unless the reference dynamics and a linear model give it exactly. | - |
| `certificate.discrepancy_action_lipschitz` | float | `null` | error per scaled action | [0.0, inf] | implemented | Declared action constant C_a of the continuity profile (variation of f - f_hat). | Used by continuity unless the reference dynamics and a linear model give it exactly. | - |
| `certificate.demonstration_residual_bound` | float | `null` | scaled state | [0.0, inf] | implemented | Declared bound on every demonstration residual ||T(z_t, a_t) - z_{t+1}||. | Bound profiles add the residual once; without certificate.reference_dynamics it must be declared. | - |
| `certificate.neighborhood_state` | float | `null` | scaled state | (0.0, inf] | implemented | Labels farther than this from their anchor state are unsupported. | Null: the constants are global. | - |
| `certificate.neighborhood_action` | float | `null` | scaled action | (0.0, inf] | implemented | Labels farther than this from their anchor action are unsupported. | Null: the constants are global; backtrack keeps the anchor's action and takes none. | - |
| `certificate.max_total_error` | float | `null` | scaled state | [0.0, inf] | implemented | Bound profiles: admit labels whose bound is at most this. | Admission is upper_bound: only bound rows (certified or conditional) are admitted. | - |
| `certificate.score_threshold` | float | `null` | scaled state | [0.0, inf] | implemented | Score profiles: admit labels whose score is at most this. | Admission is score: rows stay empirical and are never presented as bounds. Legacy aug.max_label_err. | `aug.max_label_err` |
| `certificate.selection_quantile` | float | `null` | - | (0.0, 1.0] | implemented | Select admitted, accepted labels whose total is at most this quantile of theirs. | A data budget; it never changes acceptance or classification. Legacy aug.label_err_quantile (0.3 in the label-filtering pendulum configs). | `aug.label_err_quantile` |
| `certificate.selection_population` | choice | `"admitted"` | - | `admitted`, `produced` | implemented | Rows the selection quantile is taken over. | admitted: accepted, admissible rows. produced: every supported row a legacy run would have generated, independently of the admission threshold and support radius, as the label-filtering branch did; migrated legacy configurations use it. | - |

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `policy.method` | choice | `"ccil"` | - | `ccil`, `bc`, `noise_bc` | implemented | Policy training data: expert plus accepted labels, expert only, or NoiseBC (ported in M3). | Replaces the policy.naive and policy.noise_bc flag combination. | `policy.naive`, `policy.noise_bc` |
| `policy.trainer` | choice | `"linear_least_squares"` | - | `linear_least_squares`, `mean_action` | implemented | Downstream policy trainer of the integrated pipeline. | Reference trainers for the integrated pipeline (#19); real policy classes plug in through PolicyTrainer. | - |
| `policy.noise_scale` | float | `null` | standardized observation units | [0.0, inf] | implemented | NoiseBC observation-noise scale: the maximum noise magnitude. | Set per suite by the legacy scripts; applied after the observation scaler, as legacy CustomBC did. | `policy.noise_bc` |
| `policy.noise_model` | choice | `"symmetric_uniform_half_batch"` | - | `symmetric_uniform_half_batch`, `legacy_uniform_half_batch` | implemented | NoiseBC noise distribution. | symmetric_uniform_half_batch adds scale*(2U-1) to half of each batch, zero-centered (#22). legacy_uniform_half_batch reproduces legacy CustomBC's scale*U[0,1), which is always positive, for parity. | - |
| `policy.noise_mask_probability` | float | `0.5` | - | [0.0, 1.0] | implemented | Probability that NoiseBC perturbs a sample in a minibatch. | Legacy CustomBC rand > 0.5. | - |
| `policy.learning_rate` | float | `0.001` | - | (0.0, inf] | implemented | Policy learning rate. | Same value in every legacy config. | `policy.lr` |
| `policy.batch_size` | int | `null` | - | [1, inf] | implemented | Policy minibatch size. | Task-specific in legacy configs. | `policy.batch_size` |
| `policy.epochs` | int | `null` | - | [1, inf] | implemented | Policy training epochs. | Task-specific in legacy configs. | `policy.train_epochs` |
| `policy.balance_noisy_labels` | bool | `false` | - | - | implemented | Repeat expert data num_labels times for noisy-action labels. | Legacy aug.balance_data: demonstrations appear labels_per_transition + 1 times and epochs are divided by labels_per_transition, for ccil with noisy-action labels. | `aug.balance_data` |
| `policy.action_scaler` | choice | `"min_max"` | - | `min_max`, `none` | implemented | Action normalization during policy training. | Legacy literal in train_bc_policy.py (d3rlpy MinMaxActionScaler to [-1, 1]). | - |
| `policy.observation_scaler` | choice | `"standard"` | - | `standard`, `none` | implemented | Observation normalization during policy training. | Legacy literal scaler='standard' in train_bc_policy.py: (x - mean) / (std + 1e-3), population std. | - |
| `policy.trainer_version` | choice | `"2"` | - | `1`, `2` | implemented | Experimental vector-policy trainer version (#108). | 2 trains groups of policies as one batched, compiled program on the device (vector_bc_v2.py); 1 is the original per-step loop (vector_bc.py), kept for comparison. Same protocol, not bit-compatible. | - |
| `policy.hidden_layers` | ints | `[256, 256]` | - | [1, inf] | implemented | Hidden-layer widths of the experimental vector policy. | d3rlpy's default VectorEncoderFactory, which legacy BC used. | - |
| `policy.exclude_validation_episodes` | bool | `true` | - | - | implemented | Train the policy on the training episodes only, holding out the split's validation episodes. | Legacy BC trained on every expert transition; its validation split (#13) only evaluated the dynamics model. Converted legacy configurations with fidelity historical set false. | - |
| `policy.demonstration_weight` | float | `1.0` | - | [0.0, inf] | implemented | Loss weight of every demonstration row. | Legacy weighted every row equally; synthetic rows keep their recorded weights (docs/supervision.md). | - |

## Cross-field rules

- `pca_dim`: `representation.kind`, `representation.dim`
- `action_bounds`: `data.action_low`, `data.action_high`
- `noise_bc_scale`: `policy.method`, `policy.noise_scale`, `policy.balance_noisy_labels`, `generation.method`
- `certificate`: `certificate.profile`, `certificate.reference_dynamics`, `generation.method`, `transition_model.kind`
